Class JwkTransformerFunction

java.lang.Object
se.swedenconnect.security.credential.nimbus.JwkTransformerFunction
All Implemented Interfaces:
Function<PkiCredential, JWK>
public class JwkTransformerFunction extends Object implements Function<PkiCredential, JWK>
A function that transforms a PkiCredential into an JWK.
Author:
Martin Lindström
